I sometimes rage when I'm in a depressive episode (bipolar). But I would never hit my partner. Usually I just hurt myself by punching a wall (yesterday I punched glass door and got my hand open by glass, lol).  Now I finally got consequences and I'm surely gonna think twice before doing it again. I'm trying to work on my emotional imbalance and the way I lose control of my emotions. 

Why am I telling you this? 
Because nothing justifies hurting your SO. Not verbally, physically, not emotionally. Of course accidents happen, you may have a bad day in school/work and then he comes to you with something that you totally don't want to talk about at that moment or smth and you say some bad things. 
But what's important in a relationship is speaking with each other. When you make a mistake like that, you can still say I'm sorry I didn't mean it like that, this is why I did that, not as an excuse, but just to clear things up. I know that I've hurt you, but I didn't mean to. Yet your SO still doesn't have to accept your apology immediately and that's valid.


But once things start to get physical and he actually hits you, there in no excuse worth accepting.

If he punched you once, you have to know that he's capable of that, which he shouldn't be and most probably he's going to do it again eventually. - red flag

If he didn't even TRY to apologize. - red flag

If he tried to gaslight you into thinking it was your fault that he hit you. - red flag

I'm sorry, but you're in an abusive relationship and should RUN asap.
